subject: Audit visibility and key management for HealthEdge POC
messages:
From: Alice Wong <alice.wong@healthedge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit visibility and key management for HealthEdge POC

Irene / Redwood team,

Thanks again for the demo — HealthEdge is interested in moving the POC forward but our security team has a few gating questions we need clarified before we can sign the SOW. I've attached a spreadsheet with the standard SOC2-style questions, but the asks below are highest priority for us to validate the POC: 

- Audit log granularity: we need request-level logs with timestamps, request_id, model name, request_type (embed/generate), and a hashed user identifier. Can you provide a redacted sample and confirm which fields are stored in hosted vs. dedicated/private?
- Retention controls: what retention windows are configurable per-tenant? Is there an admin control to set retention to 30/90/365 days?
- BYOK/KMS: does Redwood support Bring Your Own Key for the hosted product, or only for private on-prem/VPC deployments? If hosted, please outline the KMS flow (escrow vs. customer-managed keys).
- SSO & audit: we require SAML-based SSO with assertion logs correlated to request logs. Can you outline how SSO events map into your audit stream?

Can you share a redacted audit log sample and a brief timeline for answers? If it's easier, we can set a 30-min call with our security lead (cc'd: security@healthedge.com).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we are targeting internal approval by the end of next week.

Best,
Alice Wong
Security Lead, HealthEdge
attachments: healthedge_soc2_questions.xlsx
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@healthedge.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit visibility and key management for HealthEdge POC

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. Looping in product (Marissa), ops (Ben) and security (Jonas) so we can triage internally and provide concrete artifacts. High-level answers below; we'll follow up with redacted samples and a proposed timeline.

High-level (pre-triage):
- Audit log granularity: we capture request_id, timestamp, model, route, request_type, latency_ms, and a user identifier that is hashed by default for hosted customers. Full PII is not stored.
- Retention controls: console currently exposes retention presets: 30 / 90 / 365 days for Dedicated and Private. For Hosted we have a default 90-day window; we can offer a temporary 30-day carveout for POCs via support for evidence delivery.
- BYOK/KMS: BYOK (customer-managed CMKs) is supported in Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem). For Hosted API we use an escrow model with HSM-backed keys and can provide attestations; we're evaluating scoped BYOK for hosted tier but it's not GA.
- SSO mapping: SAML assertions are logged in our IdP connector and correlated via a shared request_id; we can export assertion timestamps and subject fields to the audit stream.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Internal sync (30-min) to map owners and artifacts — target Wed 03/28 11:00-11:30 PT.
2) Ben to produce a redacted sample log for HealthEdge by Thu 03/29 EOD.
3) Marissa to confirm console options and timeline for exposing retention presets (if a short-term UI toggle is required).
4) Jonas to draft a 1-page compliance statement describing KMS/escrow modes for the POC.

I'll put a short internal triage doc in Drive and share the link.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Product Security, Redwood Inference
attachments: internal-triage-notes.md
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Wong <alice.wong@healthedge.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit visibility and key management for HealthEdge POC

Thanks for the triage plan — quick product notes so expectations are aligned for the POC: 

- Retention: Console-presets (30/90/365) are available for Dedicated and Private. For Hosted we can accept a short-term support request to deliver a 30-day evidence export; making the preset visible in the hosted console will require a small UI change (~2 sprints) and a short security review.

- BYOK: Full customer-controlled key rotation and zero-knowledge access is only available on Private (customer KMS integration). For the Hosted POC we can provide HSM-backed escrow with audit attestations and a controlled export process. If HealthEdge requires BYOK during the POC we recommend moving to a Private trial image (VPC) — I can coordinate product-engineering availability.

- SSO correlation: We can surface assertion_id and subject in the audit export CSV. If you need full SAML traces, that's in the IdP logs; we can join those to request logs during evidence delivery.

Open product asks for the team: 
- Do they need an admin UI toggle for retention during the POC, or will a documented support-export be sufficient?
- If they require BYOK, confirm whether they can host a VPC/private test or need hosted-level assurance only.

I'll be on the internal sync and can bring engineering timelines.

—Marissa
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Wong <alice.wong@healthedge.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit visibility and key management for HealthEdge POC

Alice / team — attaching a redacted sample log (redacted_audit_sample.log) and a short ops note here.

Ops notes / sample contents: 
- Fields in sample: timestamp, request_id, route, model, request_type, duration_ms, status_code, source_ip (redacted to subnet), user_hash, assertion_id (if SSO), kube_node, storage_bucket_path.
- Hosted vs Dedicated/Private: hosted stores the same schema but hashes user identifiers and omits kube_node and internal hostnames. Dedicated/Private includes those infra fields if the customer deploys in their VPC.
- Delivery options: we can (A) provide a one-off redacted export (by date range) within 48 business hours, or (B) set up a streaming audit forwarder into a customer S3 bucket for the Private/Dedicated trial.

Action items assigned: 
- Ben: deliver redacted sample (done, attached) and provide S3 forwarding doc if they want streaming.
- Jonas: compile KMS/escrow attestation wording and confirm which logs are available with BYOK flows.
- Marissa: confirm UI/console option for retention toggle (short-term support vs product change).

Alice — would Wed 04/03 09:00 PT work for a 30-min call to review the sample and confirm which delivery option you'd prefer?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Platform Ops, Redwood Inference
